headline: Nifty drops sharply as *fear surges* in the market
subline: The market faced widespread selling with a rise in volatility.
hero_text: Fear rose sharply today as the India VIX spiked 10.01%. Broader market also fell.

why.title: FII Net Selling
why.desc: FIIs pulled money from the market.

sector_reasons.Private Bank: Faced selling pressure with broader banks
sector_reasons.Energy: Under pressure from crude price surge

bonus_text: India VIX rose sharply, signaling heightened market fear.
movers_note_gainers: INFY and TECHM edged higher in a sea of red.
movers_note_losers: ADANIENT and JSWSTEEL led the declines.
watch_text: Tomorrow's UoM Consumer Sentiment data at 23:30 IST will be key.
lessons: Broad-based declines occurred without a single catalyst.
FII selling weighed heavily on market sentiment.
Rising crude prices intensified inflation fears.
